classification_gates.high_complementarity: union_increment_over_best_count >= 106 AND jaccard <= 0.75 AND both conditional recovery rates >= 0.20
classification_gates.limited_complementarity: not HIGH and (union_increment_over_best_count >= 22 OR jaccard < 0.90 OR either conditional recovery rate >= 0.05)
classification_gates.negligible_complementarity: authority valid and neither HIGH nor LIMITED
classification_gates.indeterminate: authority, identity, partition, or replay verification failure

both_timing: per-separator signed and absolute displacement summaries

fusion_gate.YES: complementarity is HIGH or LIMITED, each separator uniquely recovers at least 22 original EME, and neither unique population is empty; principle must be operable without original-stem authority
fusion_gate.NO: complementarity is NEGLIGIBLE or one separator-specific population is empty
fusion_gate.INDETERMINATE: audit authority/replay is indeterminate or evidence does not satisfy YES/NO

population_definitions.A_BOTH: original_eme_id occurs in both frozen matched lists
population_definitions.B_DEMUCS_ONLY: original_eme_id occurs only in frozen htdemucs_ft matched list
population_definitions.C_RX_ONLY: original_eme_id occurs only in frozen RX matched list
population_definitions.D_NEITHER: original authority ID occurs in neither frozen matched list

replay.serialization: UTF-8 canonical JSON; sorted keys; compact separators; trailing LF
